risks.risk: Screen is not touch-sensitive as claimed
risks.proof: A video or photo showing touch interaction on the screen (e.g., swiping, tapping with finger).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-touch screen, which reduces value.

risks.risk: RAM is less than 8GB or not 8GB
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information or task manager showing installed RAM.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 4GB or lower, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: HDD is not 1TB or is a smaller SSD
risks.proof: Screenshot of Disk Management or File Explorer showing drive size and type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 500GB or SSD, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Keyboard backlight does not work or is not present
risks.proof: Photo or video showing keyboard lit in dark environment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no backlight, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Laptop has physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Full 360-degree video or close-up photos of all edges, hinges, and screen bezel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having minor wear, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Screenshot of system information showing RAM and storage details.
Video or photo showing touch screen functionality.
Photo or video showing keyboard backlight in dark.
Full 360-degree video of the laptop showing all sides and hinges.
Photo of the laptop's bottom or internal drive if possible.
response.reason: The model and processor are confirmed, but key claims (RAM, storage, touch screen, keyboard light) cannot be verified from current photos. Hidden risks affect pricing significantly, and without proof, the item must be priced at worst-case assumptions, which would be lower than advertised. Proof is needed to confirm specifications and condition.
